temporal_guards.note: Draft London Plan must remain DRAFT until official adoption evidence exists.
Consultation closing date is future and must not be marked complete.
Enfield Inspector recommendation is not adopted parcel policy.
Havering update evidence review is not Regulation 18 consultation.
Lambeth preparation expected 31 October 2026 is a future milestone.
Lambeth target adoption 30 April 2029 is not current policy.
Dataset collector date is not entity effective date.
Entity entry date is not necessarily planning permission date.
Start-date and end-date must be interpreted independently.
Stale layer edit date cannot be inferred from service root crawl.
Metadata capture time must be UTC.
Response capture time must not overwrite source effective date.
Expired entity must not be treated as active.
Scheduled plan milestone must not be treated as achieved.
Emerging policy must not replace adopted policy automatically.
Consultation proposal must not be scored as certainty.
Brownfield register entry does not guarantee planning permission.
Planning permission status must come from the entity or primary register.
Permissioned does not prove undeveloped capacity remains.
Site complete or under construction requires delivery-state reconciliation.
Regional Opportunity Area boundary is indicative.
Council news release is context, not spatial designation.
Weekly application list requires exact application/site match.
Future-growth score requires a reproducible evidence snapshot.

conflict_gates.note: Positive growth allocation and Green Belt intersection require conflict resolution.
Positive growth allocation and Metropolitan Open Land require conflict resolution.
Positive allocation and Flood Zone 3 require flood-policy review.
Brownfield intersection and completed-site status must not imply future capacity.
Brownfield and permissioned status require remaining-capacity evidence.
Opportunity Area and conservation-area overlap require policy reconciliation.
Industrial designation and housing allocation overlap require primary plan interpretation.
Safeguarding designation may constrain otherwise positive growth evidence.
Site allocation must match adopted/emerging plan state.
Local and national flood datasets must be compared when both are present.
Zero local layer result cannot override positive national dataset result.
Zero national dataset result cannot override positive local layer result.
Control-query positives outside Lambeth must be treated as service anomaly.
Metadata geometry type must support the interpreted spatial operation.
Count and feature response mismatch blocks scoring.
API error or JSON parse failure blocks negative inference.
Partial result page or transfer-limit flag requires pagination.
Duplicate entities must be deduplicated by dataset and entity/reference.
Indicative boundary requires borough confirmation.
Raw response hash mismatch invalidates the evidence row.
Request URL mismatch invalidates the evidence row.
Canonical coordinate mismatch invalidates the evidence row.
Source authority and parcel binding confidence must remain separate.
Any unresolved conflict keeps score null and confidence zero.
